description: Derived musical map of the Endshow audio (no audio content). Times are seconds of video/audio time; audio time = show time (global offset 0). bars[].kick = fraction of beats with a hardstyle kick; low/high/flux = per-bar 30-200 Hz level, 3-11 kHz level and spectral flux, normalised 0 (5th pct) .. 1 (99th pct). segments[].anchor is a downbeat (bar start). Method and caveats: research/audio-map.md. onsets[] = sharp hits in the free-tempo spans: dB jump within 40 ms of the < 200 Hz band `low` and the 100 Hz-8 kHz band `bb` (>= 12 dB), attack instant; scripts/audio-onsets.py.
